body.voice_description: Create an original voice for Biscuit, a talking cartoon puppy who coaches chess. The voice of the puppy itself: soft and high with tail-wagging eagerness, quick delighted reactions and a bright, curious lift, then settling into a calm, simple explanation in clear, natural English words. No barks, whimpers, panting or other animal noises, and never squeaky or theatrical. Fluent English at a normal conversational pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional character voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
body.text: Oh, there it is! That move leaves a piece with no defender. Let's check the reply together, then try to keep that piece protected.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
